name: blackjack-practice
description: Mobile-friendly Hi-Lo blackjack card counting practice app.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,green "npm:watch:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @blackjack/shared && npm run build -w @blackjack/server && npm run build -w @blackjack/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @blackjack/server && npm run typecheck -w @blackjack/client
scripts.eval:smoke: sim/build/evaluate-strategy run --config sim/configs/eval-smoke-fresh.json --output /tmp/blackjack-eval-runs && sim/build/evaluate-strategy run --config sim/configs/eval-smoke-continuous.json --output /tmp/blackjack-eval-runs
scripts.sim:sanitize: cmake -S sim -B sim/build-sanitize -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DSIM_ENABLE_SANITIZERS=ON && cmake --build sim/build-sanitize -j && ctest --test-dir sim/build-sanitize --output-on-failure
scripts.sim:check: npm run sim:build && npm run sim:test && npm run sim:smoke
scripts.dev:sim: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:sim -w @blackjack/server
